summary: Extends the SDP grouping framework so several media streams can be tied to a single resource reservation flow. It defines the syntax and a new grouping semantics value called Single Reservation Flow. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a video and its sound should share one reserved lane on the road instead of two. This memo adds a way to say so in the description of a call.

questions: sdp group media streams into one reservation
